about.title: About EvolveTech
about.missionText: EvolveTech engineers mission-critical financial software and enterprise AI infrastructure for emerging Asian markets. We empower SMEs and commercial establishments with regulatory-grade software previously confined to tier-1 financial institutions.
about.visionText: Positioning EvolveTech as a scalable Fintech and AI infrastructure platform across Southeast Asia, bridging informal retail revenues into standardized digital ledgers ready for compliance and institutional credit.
